verdict.rationale: Visa publishes a discoverable MCP server (Agent Toolkit) that exposes its Intelligent Commerce APIs (invoicing, payment links, tokens) as tools an agent can enumerate, and the developer portal serves a machine-readable llms.txt discovery index; the toolkit is also listed on npm for programmatic discovery. This covers discovery of Visa's own payable APIs but not a broader directory/marketplace of third-party payable services that agents could browse. Missing for 10: a multi-merchant/service discovery registry beyond Visa's own API surface, and independent confirmation that agents actually enumerate/use the MCP tool list in practice.
